protocol_status: Anonymous website price endpoint identified in PRD source analysis; no stable developer compatibility guarantee asserted.
mapping: Exact forward asset + USD symbol lookup; use index string, ignore bid/ask buffers.
All prices must be positive decimal strings; duplicate symbols, malformed timestamps or envelopes reject the whole snapshot.
No inferred stablecoin peg, inverse pair, perpetual mark price or suffix-based exchange-rate inference.
calculations: Spot total = free + locked; available = free; each multiplied by asset USD index.
Futures wallet = walletBalance x asset index; margin = (walletBalance + provided asset unrealizedProfit) x index. Missing UPL remains unknown.
Wallet reference USD sum excludes UPL, other accounts, Staking/Grid/Vault/prediction, collateral discounts and costs.
BTC display divides exact USD by BTCUSD. Wallet BTC divides once after exact USD aggregation.
Hide-low predicate uses exact USD x 10000 > BTCUSD; equal threshold excluded. Unknown/stale asset or BTC prices and stale account snapshots remain visible.

freshness_policy.failed_refresh: Retain displayed estimates, mark stale, do not hide assets using them.
freshness_policy.lifecycle: Pause cancels timers; resume reads public prices; generations discard late results; no account signing.
